Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.
But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. Finance Process Manager (m/f/d)

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here (https://bertelsmann-hr.de/docs/Overview_of_Data_Retention_Periods_EN.pdf) .

The German Diabetes Center (DDZ), Leibniz Institute for Diabetes Research at Heinrich Heine University (HHU) Düsseldorf is an interdisciplinary research institute that integrates basic, translational and clinical research to improve the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of diabetes mellitus and its complications. The Institute for Clinical Biochemistry and Pathobiochemistry (Director: Prof. Dr. Hadi Al-Hasani) investigates the molecular mechanisms underlying insulin resistance, skeletal muscle metabolism and type 2 diabetes.

For a new research project, we are looking for a talented and highly motivated

Doctoral Student (PhD / Dr. rer. nat., m/f/div., E13 TV-L 65%)

to join our interdisciplinary research team investigating the molecular mechanisms by which repeated
cold exposure improves skeletal muscle insulin sensitivity.

Insulin resistance of skeletal muscle is a key feature in the development of type 2 diabetes, accounting for the majority of impaired postprandial glucose disposal. While lifestyle interventions such as exercise are well established, repeated cold exposure has recently emerged as a promising strategy to improve insulin sensitivity in humans, with reported improvements of up to 40%. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying these beneficial metabolic adaptations remain largely unknown.

The project aims to identify the signaling pathways responsible for cold-induced improvements in skeletal muscle insulin action. A particular focus will be placed on testing the hypothesis that mild cold-induced muscle activation ("micro-shivering"), rather than brown adipose tissue activation, mediates these metabolic benefits.

The project combines translational human studies with mechanistic investigations in mouse models and offers extensive training in state-of-the-art metabolic and molecular research techniques.
Proteomic analysis of human skeletal muscle biopsies obtained from cold acclimation studies to identify molecular signatures associated with improved insulin sensitivity.
Mechanistic studies in wild-type and UCP1-deficient mice to investigate the effects of cold exposure and muscle activation on glucose uptake and insulin action.
Functional characterization of established and novel regulators of skeletal muscle metabolism, including AMPK, GLUT4, Rac1 and newly identified candidate proteins.
Investigation of GLUT4 trafficking and insulin signaling using advanced molecular and cellular approaches.

The project offers training in:

Mass spectrometry-based proteomics
Mouse models of insulin resistance and metabolic disease
Indirect calorimetry and metabolic phenotyping
Glucose uptake assays in isolated skeletal muscle
Molecular biology techniques (Western blotting, qPCR, gene expression analyses)
Immunohistochemistry and skeletal muscle fibre typing

In vivo electroporation and functional gene manipulation
Fluorescence-based analysis of GLUT4 translocation

You hold (or are close to obtaining) a Master's degree in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Molecular Medicine, Physiology, Biomedical Sciences or a related discipline.
You have practical experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques such as Western blotting, qPCR and cell culture.
Experience with metabolic phenotyping, skeletal muscle biology, mouse models or proteomics is advantageous but not required.
You enjoy interdisciplinary research and are interested in combining human physiology with mechanistic laboratory studies.
You are highly motivated, curious, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment.
You have an excellent command of written and spoken English.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a "Gas Turbine R&D – Project Engineer" you are a committed, independent and creative personality with knowledge of gas turbines and basic knowledge of project management. As a member of the Gas Turbine Engineering Project Management Office Team, you will support global project management in the planning, implementation and controlling of R&D projects / programs. In addition to classic project management tools, you will also apply modern agile methods such as SCRUM for the cooperation of the development teams.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Fostering the standard execution schedule as a knowledge base for other parties supporting time scheduling in Large Gas Turbine R&D projects
* You establish and coordinate overview of budget, milestones and resource plans to facilitate regular monitoring
* Facilitate execution through coordination across multiple functions including engineering, business controlling, supply management, manufacturing development and other interfaces as required
* Furthermore, you support project/program portfolio planning, prioritization and resource allocation
* You facilitate regular program reviews, support resolution of resource, budget or schedule conflicts as needed
* You facilitate project stand up meetings / SCRUM meetings

What You Bring

* Successfully completed Master’s degree in a technical or business-related field
* Proven professional experience in relevant areas such as gas or steam turbines, project management, and project controlling is desirable
* Proficient in standard software (MS Office); experience with project management tools (e.g., MS Project) and project scheduling is an advantage
* Technical product knowledge in the field of large gas turbines (e.g., SGT5-4000F, SGT5/6-2000E or comparable LGT frames) is desirable but not mandatory
* Business-fluent German and English, both written and spoken, as well as intercultural competence
* Strong teamwork and communication skills, decision-making ability, problem-solving competence, assertiveness, and a clear sense of goals complete your profile

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs 

#RPO #LGTEN #ELECTRON

jobs.description:
At IONOS, the leading European provider of cloud infrastructure, cloud services and hosting services, you will work together with a wide range of teams. We are characterized by open structures, a friendly working culture and flat hierarchies with a strong team spirit. We firmly believe that work and fun are compatible, and offer you the right environment for this. Our constant growth means that we are always looking for new colleagues. Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

Your Responsibilities

To ensure an optimal experience and quality of service for our clients, we are looking to strengthen our dedicated French customer support team.

- First Point of Contact: Accompany clients in using our products and services, from understanding their initial request through to full resolution.
- Needs Analysis: Evaluate client inquiries to quickly identify their requirements and deliver clear, efficient, and tailored solutions.
- Technical Support: Assist clients with diverse technical issues and guide them through using our suite of products and services.
- Quality Communication: Maintain high standards of written and verbal communication, adapting your tone and technical level to each client's expertise.
- Value Addition: Identify relevant opportunities to introduce complementary products or services that genuinely fit client needs.
- Client Retention: Use your adaptability, patience, and customer-first mindset to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.
- Team Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues and share knowledge to support the team's overall performance.

Your profile

Are you passionate about IT and looking for your first professional role in a technical field, or do you want to further develop your skills?

We have a role for you!

- You have knowledge of UNIX/Linux environments such as Debian, Ubuntu, etc.
- You are familiar with LAMP development environments and/or web technologies and languages such as HTML, PHP, databases, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, etc.
- Curious about new technologies, you are keen to explore, experiment and discover the latest developments in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI).
- You enjoy understanding problems, investigating their causes and finding solutions.
- You are dynamic and keen to play an active role in your team’s development.
- You are an excellent listener and are comfortable interacting with clients.
- You have very good communication skills, both spoken and written, and know how to adapt your approach to suit the person you are speaking to.
- You are patient, curious, adaptable and enjoy working as part of a team.
- You are comfortable with the commercial side of things and know how to identify a relevant solution or product whilst prioritising the client’s actual needs.
- Fluency in English and/or German would be an advantage.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Generali Operations Service Platform (GOSP) supports the Generali Group in optimizing digital services and service quality. GOSP utilizes shared technology platforms for the group.
As a joint venture partner, Accenture supports transformation, innovation, and scaling. GOSP develops solutions for digitalization and the implementation of a cloud-centric model, encompassing areas such as IT infrastructure, procurement, security operations, and anti-money laundering.

That is the job

The Group Procurement unit manages the sourcing and purchasing of goods and services across the organization to ensure cost efficiency and supplier consistency. It centralizes procurement activities to leverage scale, optimize contracts, and support strategic business goals.

We're looking for a Senior Strategic Buyer (m/f/d) to lead sourcing initiatives within the Generali Group's Real Estate & Facility Management (RE&FM) domain. The position is limited until 30.06.2027. The role involves developing procurement strategies, managing supplier relationships, driving cost optimization, and ensuring compliance with procurement policies, while collaborating with internal stakeholders to support business objectives.

Key responsibilities of the role will include:

- Lead strategic sourcing initiatives in RE&FM within the Generali group
- Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business goals and compliance standards
- Manage supplier relationships, including negotiation, performance evaluation, and risk mitigation
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders (finance, legal, operations, etc) to ensure procurement alignment with project needs
- Drive cost optimization and value creation through market intelligence and benchmarking
- Support contract management and ensure adherence to procurement policies and procedures
- Monitor procurement KPIs and prepare regular reporting for senior stakeholders

Profile

- University degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field
- Minimum 2 years of experience in strategic procurement, preferably in an international environment
- Proven experience managing sourcing activities for real estate services, facility operations, maintenance, and capital projects
- Familiarity with vendor management in RE&FM categories such as cleaning, security, catering, HVAC, and energy services
- Proficient in procurement platforms (e.g., SAP Ariba, Ivalua)
- Strong knowledge of strategic sourcing, contract negotiation, and supplier performance management
- Familiarity with risk assessment and compliance frameworks
- Understanding of RE&FM-specific KPIs, SLAs, and sustainability metrics
- Experience with lease administration, property lifecycle cost analysis, and FM service benchmarking
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
-  Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities as well as high attention to detail and ability to deliver under tight deadlines
- Proactive, adaptable, solution-oriented mindset and team player with cross-functional collaboration experience
-  Ability to influence internal clients and drive cost optimization without compromising service quality
- Fluent in English (written and spoken) / German, Czech, or other European language is a plus

Process Operator (f/m/d)

Place of work: Production site, near Chemnitz, Germany
Start date: ASAP
Contract type: Full-time

About us

We’re on a mission to revolutionize how the world produces protein and we’re just getting started.

Pacifico is a Leipzig-based biotech company producing the world’s most cost-competitive texturized protein through fermentation. Our technology makes sustainable, high-quality protein cheaper than conventional meat production – not just better for the planet, but better for you.

Our production site near Chemnitz is where science meets scale: industrial fermentation systems, food-grade processing lines, and a team that moves fast. We’re now looking for a Process Operator (f/m/d) to support the day-to-day facility operations at our production site.

The role

In this role, you will support the operations of our fermentation facility and all related processing steps. You will work closely with a Senior Process Lead and will be trained on our equipment, processes, and quality standards.

The role is strongly hands-on and operational, with a focus on running equipment, preparing materials, and supporting production. Working hours are initially within typical daytime working hours; as production scales, openness to late and occasional weekend shifts is valued.

Your main tasks

- Preparation of fermentation media (weighing, mixing, heating, handling raw materials)
- Operating fermentation tanks and auxiliary equipment
- Supporting downstream processing (emptying tanks, handling and processing biomass)
- Operating our food processing line and its associated equipment
- Monitoring basic process parameters (e.g. temperature, time, filling levels)
- Cleaning and sanitising equipment (CIP systems and manual cleaning)
- Maintaining cleanliness, order, and safety in the facility
- Documenting basic production activities and flagging issues when they arise

Your profile

- Practical experience in food & beverage or similar manufacturing environments
- Comfortable working in a production setting with physical tasks and machinery
- Careful, reliable, and quality-oriented working style
- Interest in food production and fermentation processes
- Ability to work well in a small team and communicate clearly on the shop floor
- Basic working knowledge of English

Nice to have

- Experience in a brewery, dairy or fermentation-based production
- Technical or vocational training in a relevant field
- Familiarity with hygiene standards and food safety practices
- Experience with CIP systems or industrial cleaning routines
- Basic working knowledge of German

What we offer

- A full-time role with clear responsibilities and growth opportunities
- 28 days of paid holiday per year
- Subsidy for the Germany Ticket (“Deutschland-Ticket”)
- Hands-on training and close collaboration with experienced colleagues

How to apply

A short CV/brief overview of your previous work experience is sufficient.
